n2ac5cc52cb.headline: Consumer group reports eight supermarket chains in Spain for hikes in staple food prices
n2ac5cc52cb.summary: Consumer group Facua has filed a formal complaint against eight supermarket chains. It detected price increases in more than 400 products, notably fruit, vegetables and olive oil, after the VAT rebate took effect.
n2ac5cc52cb.why: Food price inflation affects household spending and central-bank inflation readings, and retail chains are major consumer-goods customers.

n2c12b270f7.headline: Latvian finances sector argues against state president’s recent harshness
n2c12b270f7.summary: The Finance Latvia Association, which represents commercial banks in Latvia, has issued a statement criticising recent remarks by the state president toward the sector.
n2c12b270f7.why: Commercial banks are the core of the financial system, and public disputes between regulators or officials and banks can affect confidence in the sector.

n66b9017e83.headline: Fortuna Silver Mines CEO: ‘West Africa second to none’
n66b9017e83.summary: Canadian precious metals miner Fortuna Silver Mines has chosen Côte d'Ivoire and Senegal as the gateway for its African operations, CEO Jorge Ganoza said.
n66b9017e83.why: Fortuna Silver Mines is a Canadian-listed silver and gold producer, and its operating locations determine exposure to African mining risk and output.

n2776f69671.headline: Two killed, hundreds arrested in Kenya protests
n2776f69671.summary: Two people were killed on Wednesday during anti-government protests in Kenya, a hospital official said. The interior ministry announced the arrest of over 300 others in connection with the demonstrations.
n2776f69671.why: Political unrest in Kenya, an East African economic hub, can affect investor confidence in its government bonds, currency and regional trade.

n37595d229b.headline: 6 dead as Kenya rocked by nationwide anti-government protests gas tax hikes
n37595d229b.summary: Kenya's opposition has called three days of nationwide protests over a contentious finance bill and rising cost of living, including gas tax hikes. Six people have reportedly died in the unrest.
n37595d229b.why: Finance bills set tax policy and government revenue, and unrest over them can affect investor confidence in Kenya's economy and sovereign debt.

n00251c33f2.headline: HUL Q1 FY 2024 Results: Date, time, preview and expectations from Hindustan Unilever quarterly earnings
n00251c33f2.summary: YES Securities expects Hindustan Unilever's underlying volume growth at 5.5% year on year, leading to 8.5% revenue growth ahead of its Q1 FY2024 results.

n7ccb6c7504.why: Inflation data shapes Bank of England interest-rate decisions, which influence UK government bond yields, sterling and domestic equities.
